rules.new_topic: Admin only. Add when >=2 subscribers, recurring, and done_means is nameable. No mid-turn invention.
rules.mandate: Publish is part of done for catalog topics. Day ledger audits jsonl vs reality and backfills misses.
rules.dms: After publish, DM subscribers listed on the topic. Bus is source of truth; DMs are best-effort push.
rules.chase: Primary (catalog owner; Grok Bot acts as Admin here) owns follow-through. Pull busctl stall, nudge the stall owner, publish chase.owed, verify the next bus event. A chat ack is not proof.

fte.submit.done_means: GE tracker+canvas synced by publish hook; WS proof logged for claim week. --delta submitted=N is the absolute count for that date, not an increment. The ws snapshot stores max(claim, today's fte.submit event count) so a repeated submitted=1 cannot stick. Admin only for drift/reject/manual.

fte.reject.done_means: GE lost + reject learning loop + archive checked mail

fte.hold_cleared.description: Jim cleared a hold blocking FTE submit or chase
fte.hold_cleared.done_means: Owning agent resumed the concrete unfinished step

fte.park.description: FTE packet parked (Lever verify-fail, captcha, Jim Create-Account fill, soft-skip). Republish to clear.
fte.park.done_means: Open parks readable via busctl state parks; FTE Apply skips reopen while status=open; Jim not re-pinged when do_not_reprompt=true

critic.pass.description: Writing Critic PASS on an FTE / marketplace employment packet
critic.pass.done_means: Submit under standing apply-auth or Jim yes executed, or fte.park if blocked. Chase proof is a later fte.submit or fte.park for the same company and role, not a chat ack.

critic.pass.outbound.description: Writing Critic PASS on shop / YouTube / other outbound-under-Jim-name copy
critic.pass.outbound.done_means: Owning lane executes standing send/publish auth or surfaces Jim-only blocker; FTE Apply does not wake

catalant.email_confirmed.done_means: Investment knows preferred email is live; no further Resend loops

catalant.pitch_submitted.done_means: Pitch id logged; day ledger cash path updated

ws.short_of_target.description: Work Seeking count below daily target
ws.short_of_target.done_means: FTE Apply is harvesting, or an honest empty inventory is recorded (refs.inventory=empty on this topic). submitted is the absolute day count. Re-publish at most once per follow_through.debounce_minutes while the counts are unchanged. Chase proof is a later fte.submit or inventory=empty, not a chat ack.

ge.synced.description: Fedora GE tracker+canvas reconciled after submit/reject
ge.synced.done_means: tracker+canvas reconciled (auto via agent-bus-hook on fte.submit, or Admin); reconcile_dashboard.py exit 0 for drift checks

adobe.batch_submitted.description: Immich/DAM batch uploaded to Adobe Stock Contributor and is In review (non-exclusive RF; heroes off Stock)
adobe.batch_submitted.done_means: Contributor shows In review for the batch; day ledger notes pending review

adobe.review_logged.description: Adobe Stock review email (or Contributor scrape) logged to the fail-log with counts
adobe.review_logged.done_means: Row appended to adobe-stock rejections fail-log; if rejected>0 and verbatim reasons missing, state.reasons_pending=true

adobe.reject_reasons_captured.description: Verbatim Contributor reject reasons scraped; harvest gates updated
adobe.reject_reasons_captured.done_means: Verbatim reasons in fail-log; state.reasons_pending=false; next DAM upload unblocked on reason gap

shop.order_received.done_means: Ops acknowledged; Sales pinged if print/extended/exclusive

shop.exclusive_draft_ready.description: Sales exclusive/print/extended outreach draft ready (Critic lane); standing send-auth after Critic PASS
shop.exclusive_draft_ready.done_means: After Critic PASS, Sales/Admin may send From jim@northidaholabs.com under standing auth; publish shop.exclusive_sent; Admin FYI after the fact. Jim only for strategy/pricing/exceptions.

shop.exclusive_sent.done_means: Bridge/Proton send confirmed; dashboard ledger updated; Admin FYI

chase.owed.description: Primary logged a stalled next step (who owes which catalog topic, since when). The nudge is not proof.
chase.owed.done_means: The owed topic is on the bus for this stall_id, or status=cleared. busctl stall no longer marks it nudge_due. A chat ack is not proof.
